mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty.point_ledger (id, tenant_id, program_id, member_id, account_id, point_type_id, transaction_type, amount, effective_at, expire_at, source_type, source_id, reference_ledger_id, operation_id, rule_id, rule_version_id, rule_version, correlation_id, calculation_snapshot) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{memberId}, #{accountId}, #{pointTypeId}, #{transactionType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{amount}, #{effectiveAt}, #{expireAt}, #{sourceType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{sourceId}, #{referenceLedgerId}, #{operationId}, #{ruleId}, #{ruleVersionId}, #{ruleVersion}, #{correlationId}, (#{calculationSnapshot})::jsonb)
mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, program_id, member_id, account_id, point_type_id, transaction_type, amount, effective_at, expire_at, source_type, source_id, reference_ledger_id, operation_id, rule_id, rule_version_id, rule_version, correlation_id, calculation_snapshot::text AS calculation_snapshot, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) FROM loyalty.point_ledger l JOIN loyalty.point_type pt ON pt.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND pt.program_id = l.program_id AND pt.id = l.point_type_id WHERE l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND l.program_id = #{programId} AND l.member_id = #{memberId} AND pt.tier_calculable = true AND l.transaction_type IN ('EARN','REVERSE','ADJUST','RECALCULATE') AND l.effective_at >= #{periodStart} AND l.effective_at < #{periodEnd}
